title: Failure and recovery of the embedding worker
purpose: ONE safe failure per run: either send one poison message to the embedding queue (--action poison-message, the default plan) or stop one embedding-worker task (--action stop-task), then show retry, dead-letter, idempotency and recovery from the queue, DLQ and worker task timelines.

environment.note: Terraform output region; no AWS call is made by this manifest.

command_notes: The command above is the DRY RUN plan print (no AWS call). The run id comes from SC_RUN_ID (the human sets it to the token passed to run-experiment.sh --run-id; run-experiment.sh does not export its run id).

HUMAN APPROVAL EDIT: to perform the failure the human removes --dry-run and appends "--queue-url", "<main embedding queue URL>", "--execute", "--yes" (for --action poison-message), or changes the action to stop-task and appends "--cluster-name", "<ECS cluster>", "--execute", "--yes". The script performs exactly ONE failure per run: --action is required and the two actions are mutually exclusive. A second failure needs a new manifest approval and a new run id; the script never retries.

Write-once record: before the first AWS call the script exclusively creates failure_drill-<run>-record.jsonl (exit 3 and no AWS call when it exists), appends each action right after it runs (failures and awscli timeouts included; a timeout is recorded as outcome_unknown) and never repeats a call.

Poison message body is a non-JSON marker string: ASSUMPTION that the worker rejects it as malformed and the redrive policy (maxReceiveCount 4) dead-letters it. Not verified against the worker code on main.
Run sample_resources.py for the whole window so retry and DLQ depth are captured.
scripts/run-experiment.sh refuses a dirty tree: commit the raw results of the previous experiment first (experiments/README.md, Between experiments).

cost_estimate.basis: one SQS message, one Fargate task for under an hour (about $0.017 per task-hour), CloudWatch reads; model reserve 0.15 USD for any embedding retries

dataset_snapshot.notes: no dataset; one synthetic poison message

scale.label: 1 safe failure: 1 poison message OR 1 stopped task (--action, mutually exclusive)
scale.note: at most ONE of the two per run

metrics_to_collect: sqs-get-queue-attributes:main queue and DLQ depth, 15 s (sample_resources.py)
ecs-describe-services:runningCount before, during and after the stop, 15 s
stop_conditions: more than one failure action (one poison message or one stopped task, never both, never repeated) would be needed: stop
DLQ depth above 1 before the drill: stop (a prior failure exists)
worker not recovered 15 minutes after the failure: report, do not scale further
the write-once record already exists, or an action ends outcome_unknown: stop, check the queue and the service by hand, never retry
reproduction: SC_RUN_ID=<token> python3 -B experiments/collect/failure_drill.py --manifest experiments/manifests/exp-f-failure-recovery.json --action poison-message --dry-run (prints the plan; or run through scripts/run-experiment.sh exp-f-failure-recovery --run-id <token> with SC_RUN_ID set); the human performs it by editing the command as in command_notes; analysis: queue_drain.py, scale_timeline.py
